full_judgment: 2. It appears that the appellants stood as sureties for the judgment-debtor in money suit and an Execution case was filed against them for non-satisfaction of the decretal dues by the judgment-debtor. The appellants appeared before the executing Court and filed objection under section 47 of the Code of Civil Procedure alleging, inter-alia, that the Execution case was barred by limitation and further that the Execution case cannot proceed against them without first proceeding against the judgment-debtor concerned. The learned Subordinate Judge, however, negatives both the contentions and rejected the application. Hence the present appeal.
